title.narrative: Youth vanguard: Bringing Together Lebanon for Social Unity

description.narrative: ¿Youth Vanguard¿ is a three-year project that aims to Enhance Social Cohesion (Objective one of the action) through specifically addressing Lot 2: promote social cohesion across communities or within the same community. It touches upon all priorities in Lot 2 with specific emphasis on promoting priority 2: a culture of intra-communal and intercommunal dialogue, understanding and respect in Lebanon through implementing three main interventions: one focused on preparing and supporting a core team of youth to be community ambassadors who design and implement community interventions (O1), one focused on implementing cross community interventions bringing together youth, public authorities, and other community members to exchange cultural experiences and engage in dialogue (O2), and one focused on participatory project management and oversight (O3).

title.narrative: Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP) Global Peace Index

description.narrative: The Global Peace Index (GPI) is a quantification of the absence of violence or the fear of violence to assess a nations level of peace. It measures a countrys level of Negative Peace using three domains of peacefulness: 1. The extent of Ongoing Domestic and International Conflict, 2. The level of Societal Safety and Security, 3. The degree of Militarisation.
